name: Shimaya Villas
description: Shimaya Villas is a calm landing-page theme for island villa companies that sell their own nights without a booking site in between. A framed photograph window opens the page with the headline on a solid panel at its corner and a dark glass hold-dates bar docked on its foot; a centred two-row header sits under a coloured promo ribbon, a grey-out list of seasons swaps a small portrait and a large photograph together, and one anchor menu leads to a single repeated Hold dates call to action. Manrope and Figtree, film-grain photography, quiet scroll effects.
